title: Contrast Effect
coreMove: Name the contrast effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Contrast Effect as a specific decision error around contrast effect, reference point, relativity. Traceable support includes . See: Charles T. Munger, Poor Charlie.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Contrast Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the contrast effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
